title: Excessive Performance
text: “I just thought delivering them to Siltvelt would take time, effort, and cover quite a distance.”
“No problem whatsoever, indeed!”
With the Portal Skill, it’s instantaneous!
“Well then, let’s hurry up and enslave them. Come now! Load these fellows into the wagon and get them processed!”

Clap clap! The Siltvelt envoy summoned the monster merchant’s subordinates and dragged the paralyzed, immobile bandits into the wagon to begin the procedure of carving slave crests into them. Enslave them, then sell them off in Siltvelt!
“…That spell that summoned a shield earlier… a wielder of a peculiar spear.”
“Bow.”
The mongrel lizardman was giving me some kind of suspicious look, but he’d find out soon enough, I say.
“Oink.”
“Oinkoink.”
“The Ritual of Dark Baptism.”
Filolial-sama seemed to sense an uncomfortable atmosphere regarding the enslavement, but it was a necessary thing, indeed.
“Well, whatever the case, let’s be off, I say!”
“Yaaay!”
“Woohoo!”
And so the wagon rolled steadily onward toward its destination. Just then, Yuki-chan and Kou’s eggs, which I’d tucked into my chest, began to squirm.
“Oh? I say.”
I took the eggs out to check on them.
“That felt like a line that should come with its own sound effect.”

Father, looking at the eggs, began humming something. Dun-dun-dun-dun… it sounded like a sound effect from some game he knew. Now that I thought about it, Father had a habit of humming whenever he was present for a Filolial-sama egg hatching.
“““Cheep!”””
Yuki-chan and Kou emerged energetically from their eggs for us.
“Ohh… Kuro-chan was pitch black, but this one and this one are white and yellow.”
“Yuki-chan and Kou, I say.”
“““Cheep!”””
Such lively voices, wonderful, I say. The moment Yuki-chan and Kou met my eyes, they climbed right up onto my shoulders. I supposed their upbringing would have to begin now as well.
“Resuming our journey, I say!”
“It’s getting lively around here.”

Things were only going to get busier and busier from here on, indeed! First and foremost, the Filolial-samas needed their meals! And so, partway through our journey by wagon, Father cooked for us. As long as I assisted with magic, Father could cook anywhere. Everyone savored the meal. Today’s dish was a simple one—skewered grilled meat from monsters we’d hunted—but Father was flawless from the sinew-cutting onward, and he even unconsciously aged the meat properly, so it was quite delicious even freshly caught.
“I think the spices came out fairly well this time.”
“Thank you for the meal… it’s delicious.”
The rabbit man held his skewer with his uninjured hand and ate. The mongrel lizardman was eating as well.
“This… is quite the luxury.”
There was a wariness in his expression, as if he suspected he was being won over through food. Probably the same wariness Keel had shown right after being purchased.
“Ha ha ha… Bow!”
The wolf barked, as if demanding seconds.
“Yes, yes. Though with everyone eating, I’m a little worried about supplies.”
“Bow! Bow bow!”
His eyes sparkled as if to say: if I hunt something, will you cook it? I want to go hunting!
“We’re still traveling, so take it easy. Besides, the Filolials over there will hunt for us, so we’ll be fine.”
“Food!”
“Foooood!”
“Huh? Kuro’s food is gone! Where’d it go!”
“You already ate it!”
“I’ll go get more!”
“This is tastier than eating usapil raw!”
“Tastier than eating the whole thing!”
“Tastier than a thrashing usapil!”
The Filolial-samas were savoring Father’s cooking too, indeed!
“Somehow… those kids are having a pretty scary conversation.”
“Whine…”
Father was watching the Filolial-samas with some concern.
“Filolial-sama are not scary, I say! They’re all just healthy and full of appetite, indeed.”
“I guess so. Busy bunch.”
Father continued cooking with practiced efficiency.
“Now then, since you’ve eaten, it’s time to work properly.”
The Siltvelt envoy warned the slaves that eating wasn’t enough—they needed to work too.
“Well then… let’s practice a bit for the next circus act. Truth is, it’s not exactly a nice act.”
Father took out his whip and readied his stance.
“Théodore, Sion, Wolf. I’m about to whip you three, so learn to act like it hurts as best you can.”
“Eh?”
“Huh?”
“Vau?”
The three slaves tilted their heads in unison. Their expressions showed utter bewilderment.
“It’d be best to demonstrate first. This is sort of my defining flaw. Well… since both Théodore and Sion have low levels, you might actually feel some real pain. Just try… not to react…”
“Father! Allow me to be struck for the sake of demonstrating the act, I say!”
“Wha— you’re taking your clothes off again!?”
“Come now! Father! Come on, come on, I say!”
I eagerly awaited Father’s wonderful whipping, indeed.
“Sigh… fine.”
Father whipped my back. It didn’t hurt in the slightest, I say! It felt like being caressed with silk.
“GYAAAAAAAAAAAAAH! It hurts, it hurts, I sayyyyy!”
I rolled and writhed about wildly!
“No, that’s way too much pain for what that was, like, what pro athlete’s mind games is this!?”
Partway through, I even burst into flame for good measure, I say.
“Whoa!? What is that!? Where’s the fire coming from!?”
Afterward, I scattered the flames and gave a refreshing thumbs-up. Of course, I was still lying on the ground at the time, I say.
“Now then, you lot should act in this same manner—”
“Don’t do that, okay? That was way too much. It’s obviously fake. What kind of bonus effect was that even supposed to be. And don’t give me that satisfied look like you just accomplished something.”
Father rattled off criticism after criticism. Was it really that bad? I’d thought it was quite the heartfelt performance.
“Sigh… I can’t even keep up with the commentary. Guess that’s Motoyasu-kun for you… well, forget about him, let’s test this one by one first.”
“Y-yes…”
“Hmm?”
“Bow?”

Father drew back the whip and let it fly at the rabbit man. Snap! The whip struck true, and the rabbit man made a show of flinching in pain, but the moment it actually hit, he just tilted his head, puzzled.
“Um… did that just… hit me? Right?”
The rabbit man asked the mongrel lizardman, who nodded. After that, he kept tilting his head over and over. Father wore a somewhat melancholy expression.
“Kyaun…”
Only Wolf let out a sound like it actually hurt.
“See, that’s the reaction—act like it hurts! That’s the whole point of practicing!”
“Indeed! Imitate me, I say. Or perhaps a moan of pleasure would do! Ahn! Like that, I say.”
“That’s not it at all!? Why do you keep doubling down on the joke?”
“…Please try it on this one as well.”
As if requesting his own verification, the mongrel lizardman asked Father to whip him too. Father, wearing a complicated expression, swung the whip.
“I—I see… so this is how it feels. But this sensation is…”
The whipped mongrel lizardman turned his back and sank deep into thought. More seriousness in your acting, I say!
“Ahn, indeed!”
“Motoyasu-kun, quiet down a bit! Stop trying to awaken people’s hidden kinks! Anyway… if you try to disrespect me after this, the slave crest will activate, so be prepared.”
“Understood.”
“Acknowledged.”
The two nodded, clearly at a loss for how else to react. Now then… Father turned to face Wolf. What would Wolf do, I wondered. He was writhing his body about like a Filolial-sama hating an injection.
“Here we go.”
Thwack! The moment Father’s whip struck Wolf, Wolf put on a display of intense pain.
“KYAIN KYAIN KYAIN! VUUUUUU! GAU!”
Immediately after, his face twisted with hatred, fangs bared, and he lunged at Father. But due to his rebellious attitude and actions, the slave crest activated, sending him rolling in genuine agony.
“Wolf’s reaction is the best so far, but… this isn’t quite right either. Wolf!”
“GAU GAU GAU!”
Having lost himself entirely, Wolf, still refusing to forgive, thrashed about in a fit of rage.
